help.title: How to write Markdown
help.intro: Markdown is a simple way to format text with a few characters. Below is everything KWiki understands. On the left is what you type, on the right is how it looks on the page.
help.limits: KWiki does not process nested lists, raw HTML, or line breaks made with two spaces. You can combine marks on one line. Branch files, upload, and git clone/push are in the Files section.
help.headings.title: Headings
help.headings.lead: More hash marks make a smaller heading. Use one to six. Put them at the start of the line, then a space.
help.paragraphs.title: Paragraphs
help.paragraphs.lead: Plain text becomes a paragraph. A blank line starts a new one.
help.paragraphs.b: Second paragraph - after a blank line.
help.emphasis.title: Bold and italic
help.emphasis.lead: Two asterisks or two underscores make text bold; one asterisk or one underscore makes it italic.
help.emphasis.sample: This is **important**, this is __also bold__, this is *emphasis* and this is _also italic_.
help.strike.title: Strikethrough
help.strike.lead: Two tildes on each side strike the text out.
help.inline_code.title: Inline code
help.inline_code.lead: Backticks mark a short file name, command, or snippet.
help.code_block.title: Code block
help.code_block.lead: Three backticks on their own line open and close a block. Text inside is not formatted.
help.lists.title: Bullet list
help.lists.lead: A line that starts with a dash or asterisk and a space becomes a list item.
help.ordered.title: Numbered list
help.ordered.lead: A number, a period, and a space at the start of the line. The page shows items in order.
help.quote.title: Quote
help.quote.lead: A greater-than sign at the start of the line. Consecutive quote lines become one block.
help.rule.title: Horizontal rule
help.rule.lead: Three or more hyphens, asterisks, or underscores on their own line draw a line. The same: `***` or `___`.
help.links.title: Link
help.links.lead: Label in square brackets, address in parentheses. The address can be a wiki page or a website.
help.links.label: Markdown help
help.images.title: Image
help.images.lead: Like a link, but with an exclamation mark at the start. Upload the file first with “Upload media”.
help.images.note: After you save, the page shows the image. Size is optional: width and height in pixels after an equals sign. You can set only width (`=400x`) or only height (`=x240`).
help.video.title: Video
help.video.lead: Same syntax as an image. Use `.mp4` or `.webm` files.
help.video.note: The page shows a player. Size works the same way: `=640x360`.
help.table.title: Table
help.table.lead: Cells separated by a pipe. The second line is hyphens. Outer `|` marks are optional.
help.combine.title: On one line
help.combine.lead: Bold, italic, code, links, and strikethrough can be mixed.
help.combine.sample: See the **[help](/help)** and the `README.md` file; this is ~~not a secret~~.
edit.heading: Heading
media.upload_hint: Up to 2 MB. The file is committed to Git when you save the page.
